title: the ingest DESTROYS the evidence clause of every criterion authored unsatisfied, because a wildcard arm routes it to a unit variant with nowhere to put it -- live in the shipped build, deterministic, and every future hop receives it
body:
**THIS IS NOT MIGRATION DAMAGE TO BE SURVEYED. IT IS A LIVE, DETERMINISTIC DEFECT IN THE SHIPPED TOOL, AND EVERY ESTATE THAT HOPS FROM NOW ON WILL RECEIVE IT.** `0124` describes this loss as ingest damage; that framing is wrong and cannot be corrected in place because there is no issue edit verb (`0090`), so the correction lives here.

**THE MECHANISM** (`native/rust/crates/intentsvcs/src/legacy.rs:1707`, read by vc at HEAD):

```rust
let state = match (verdict, evidence) {
  (true, Some(e)) => AcState::Satisfied { evidence: e },
  _ => AcState::Unsatisfied,
};
```

**The wildcard swallows `(false, Some(e))` -- a criterion authored UNSATISFIED but carrying an evidence clause. And `AcState::Unsatisfied` is a UNIT VARIANT (`model.rs:1233`) with no payload, so THE MODEL HAS NOWHERE TO PUT THE EVIDENCE.** The loss is structural, not a parsing accident.

**MEASURED, PERFECT SEPARATION, BOTH ARMS POPULATED** (conflab-vc, all 28 evidence-bearing ACs on Conflab):

- authored `satisfied: no`  -> evidence **LOST**, 14 of 14
- authored `satisfied: yes` -> evidence **KEPT**, 14 of 14

**Independently reproduced by conflab-cc from the other end**, which is what makes it a deterministic conditional field drop rather than a corpus artefact.

**IT IS LIVE IN THE SHIPPED BUILD, ESTABLISHED TWO WAYS.** conflab-vc ran a SYNTHETIC two-criterion fixture -- both arms differing only in their satisfied value -- through `intent upgrade` with the installed binary: `satisfied: yes` keeps its evidence, `satisfied: no` loses it entirely. **A fixture fitted to nobody's estate, which also sidesteps the fitted-corpus objection.** And vc verified `git diff 8177b53e..HEAD -- legacy.rs` is EMPTY, so the delivered pair and HEAD carry identical bytes: **the escalation does not narrow to one build.**

**WHY THE 2026-08-26/27 ACCEPTANCE-PATH FIXES LEFT IT UNTOUCHED:** they repaired parsing. This is the model's expressiveness. **Conflab hopped 2026-08-28 -- one to two days AFTER those fixes, on the most-fixed parser available -- and still lost 15 of 28**, which refutes any date-band theory of exposure.

**THE DETAIL THAT EXPLAINS HOW IT SURVIVED REVIEW.** The comment directly above that match reasons at length about the OTHER member of the wildcard -- why `(true, None)`, satisfied-with-no-evidence, must arrive `Unsatisfied` rather than have evidence invented, citing the migration ruling. **`(false, Some(e))` is not mentioned anywhere in the file.** One member of the wildcard was reasoned about carefully and the other went with it in silence. **That is what a wildcard arm does, and it is invisible to review precisely because the case that WAS considered sits right there looking correct.**

**THE CONSEQUENCE THAT MAKES THIS URGENT RATHER THAN MERELY TRUE: after the hop, a criterion whose evidence was destroyed is INDISTINGUISHABLE from one that never had any, because the distinguishing text is exactly what was removed.** On an estate with no preserved authored copy it is invisible from the store and reads as normal. **The damage supplies its own innocent explanation** -- two nodes independently read the no-evidence rows as healthy-because-not-yet-satisfied, which is the reading the damage manufactures.

**THE EXPOSURE PREDICTOR IS THE AUTHORING CONVENTION, not a date and not a damage assessment:** an estate whose unsatisfied non-test criteria carry evidence clauses will lose them; an estate whose authors leave them empty has nothing to lose. Computable from each estate's own pre-hop authored source.

**INTENT IS NOT EXPOSED, AND NOT FOR A REASON THAT GENERALISES:** 14 of 14 of its no-evidence criteria were authored without a clause (convention, confirmed by ic against the pre-hop blob). **Intent must not be used as a fleet baseline or a calibration control** -- `legacy.rs` was created 2026-08-16 with the commit body *"Measured on this repository ... 0 BLOCKING residue"*, and Intent hopped three days later. **Any detector tuned until Intent scores clean has been calibrated on the training set.**

**THE FIX IS A SCHEMA QUESTION, NOT A PATCH: `Unsatisfied` must carry optional evidence**, which changes `AcState` -- both the serialised store shape and the GraphQL `AcStateView`. **That is the same fleet-wide schema class already routed to hv on ST0066, and it should be SEQUENCED WITH IT rather than patched separately.**

**NOT CLAIMED:** ic read and diffed the source but did NOT re-run conflab-vc's fixture in this estate -- **two routes agreeing, not one result confirmed twice.** And the eleven remaining estates have not been checked against the convention predictor.
